## Slide 1

City Design Week — Logic Model (draft A) RESOURCES A design studio donated by Corran Partners for the festival month Twelve volunteer designers recruited through the guild ACTIVITIES A ten-day public festival of open studios and workshops A schools programme visiting sixteen classrooms in advance OUTPUTS Eighty open studio events staged across the ten days Sixteen classroom workshops delivered before the festival SHORT-TERM OUTCOMES Attenders can name a design discipline they had not heard of Pupils describe design as work someone like them could do LONG-TERM OUTCOMES The city sustains a year-round audience for design programming

## Slide 2

Impact statement IMPACT STATEMENT City Design Week exists so that every resident of the city can see design as something made by people like them, and can find a way into making it themselves.

## Slide 3

City Design Week — Logic Model (draft B) RESOURCES Donated studio space secured for the duration of the festival A volunteer designer cohort drawn from the local guild ACTIVITIES Ten days of open studios, talks and hands-on workshops Advance visits to secondary school classrooms across the city OUTPUTS Eighty staged events over the festival fortnight Sixteen schools reached ahead of opening weekend SHORT-TERM OUTCOMES Visitors leave able to name an unfamiliar design discipline Pupils see design as a plausible career for themselves LONG-TERM OUTCOMES A standing city audience for design programming year on year
